ModMetaData.name: Mengwu Expanded - Animals Renew (unofficial)
ModMetaData.author: DiamondJ, art by Yu Yan and Frolg - 1.6 port: nelim
ModMetaData.description:
UNOFFICIAL. This mod is published without the original author's explicit consent. If the original author contacts me to request its removal, I undertake to take it down promptly.
The four animals of [SZ] Mengwu Expanded, brought forward to RimWorld 1.6. The steppe horse and three small beasts of the grassland.
THE ANIMALS ONLY. The source mod is a Mongolian-themed expansion: weapons, armour, clothing, hats, backstories and these four animals. Only the animals are here, which is what the name says. Nothing else of it was taken, and nothing else of it is needed.
I am not the author of this mod. The animals are DiamondJ's, with art by Yu Yan and Frolg; all I did was the work needed to make them run on 1.6. Credit goes to them, mistakes in the update are mine. If they come back to it, or ask me to take this down, it comes down.
Original mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2894159932 - last supporting 1.4, last updated in December 2022. Abandoned, not withdrawn.
WHAT IT ADDS
Four animals.
The Mengwu horse is the one that matters: body size 2.6, move speed 7, forty years of life, trainable to Advanced, a pack animal, and wildness 0.1 - nearly born tame. A steppe horse that carries.
Then three small ones: the Mogul leaping bunny, the rabbit mantle and the Mongolian woody groundhog. Body sizes 0.3 to 0.75, twelve to fifteen years, wildness 0.35 for the bunny and cat and 0.6 for the groundhog; the bunny is trainable to Intermediate.
The Chinese source defs are covered by 28 DefInjected entries in each of English and French, including animal names, descriptions, attacks, horse meat and the foal label. Original English animal names are retained; descriptions and missing fields have been corrected.
WHAT CHANGED IN THE 1.6 UPDATE
Wildness was migrated on all four animals. Wildness stopped being a field of RaceProperties in 1.6 and became a StatDef declared under statBases. The old form is not an error, it is simply never read, and the stat defaults to -1, outside the range the game uses - so the horse written to be nearly born-tame at 0.1 behaved like anything else.
No balance value was changed.
Content mod: removing it mid-save will lose any of these four animals already in play.
Source, changelog and the full account of the port: https://github.com/vbardales/Rimworld-Mengwu-Expanded-Animals-Renew
The original states no licence anywhere - no file, nothing in its About, no repository, nothing on its Workshop page. This port therefore rests on the Workshop's own custom for abandoned mods: named credit to the author, and a takedown on request.
If I do not answer within a reasonable time after being contacted, anyone may freely update this or any other of my mods, including publishing a continuation of it. All credit must be preserved.
The update work was done with the help of an AI assistant (Claude, by Anthropic).
